positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: C-SAMBA (Center for the Synthesis of Advanced Materials for Biomedical Applications) at UCR is a lab that focuses on developing a transparent, cranial implant in the skull as a part of the multi-institutional Window to the Brain Project. The project branches out to numerous areas of research and focus such as optical imaging and therapy and laser processing.

positions.title: Data Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: The Center for Geospatial Sciences at UCR is dedicated towards refining and enhancing geographical information and spatial data, with areas of research that include spatial optimization and big spatial data.

positions.title: Alumni Ambassador
positions.description:
Global Glimpse is a nonprofit organization aimed at promoting global education and awareness to students across the nation. Each year, students are nominated and selected to travel abroad to third-world countries such as Nicaragua and the Dominican Republic where they gain the opportunity to be globally educated about the country's culture and background as a means of recognizing the gap between there and first-world countries.

• Served as an ambassador representative for incoming Senior high school students participating in the Global Glimpse program.
• Assisted in planning and leading on monthly after-school workshops throughout the year alongside teachers participating in the program.
• Communicated with Global Glimpse employees to analyze, update, and track the progress of the students.
• Worked with the high school Global Glimpse Club to hold fundraisers and events for the students' benefits.
